mapper.select: SELECT p.prjct_sq AS prjctSq, e.entrprs_name AS entrprsName, p.prjct_ttl AS prjctTtl, p.prjct_tpy AS prjctTpy, p.prjct_work AS prjctWork, p.prjct_use_skl AS prjctUseSkl, p.prjct_esntl_skl AS prjctEsntlSkl, p.prjct_esntl_crr AS prjctEsntlCrr, p.prjct_strt_date AS prjctStrt, p.prjct_end_date AS prjctEnd, p.prjct_lctn AS prjctLctn, p.ntfctn_send_yn AS ntfctnSendYn, p.prjct_prd AS prjctPrd FROM P5_TBL_PROJECT p JOIN P3_TBL_ENTERPRISE_MEMBER_M e ON p.entrprs_sq = e.entrprs_sq

SELECT p.prjct_sq AS prjctSq, e.entrprs_name AS entrprsName, p.prjct_ttl AS prjctTtl, p.prjct_tpy AS prjctTpy, p.prjct_work AS prjctWork, p.prjct_use_skl AS prjctUseSkl, p.prjct_esntl_skl AS prjctEsntlSkl, p.prjct_esntl_crr AS prjctEsntlCrr, p.prjct_strt_date AS prjctStrt, p.prjct_end_date AS prjctEnd, p.prjct_lctn AS prjctLctn, p.ntfctn_send_yn AS ntfctnSendYn, p.prjct_prd AS prjctPrd FROM P5_TBL_PROJECT p JOIN P3_TBL_ENTERPRISE_MEMBER_M e ON p.entrprs_sq = e.entrprs_sq WHERE prjct_sq = #{prjctSq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO P5_TBL_PROJECT( entrprs_sq, prjct_ttl, prjct_tpy, prjct_work, prjct_use_skl, prjct_esntl_skl, prjct_esntl_crr, prjct_strt_date, prjct_end_date, prjct_prd, prjct_lctn, prjct_cntnt ) VALUES( #{entrprsSq}, #{prjctTtl}, #{prjctTpy}, (SELECT job_mc_name FROM P2_TBL_JOB_CODE_S WHERE job_sq = #{prjctWork}), #{prjctUseSkl}, #{prjctEsntlSkl}, #{prjctEsntlCrr}, #{prjctStrtDate}, #{prjctEndDate}, #{prjctPrd}, #{prjctLctn}, #{prjctCntnt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE P5_TBL_PROJECT SET entrprs_sq = #{entrprsSq}, prjct_ttl = #{prjctTtl}, prjct_tpy = #{prjctTpy}, prjct_work = #{prjctWork}, prjct_use_skl = #{prjctUseSkl}, prjct_esntl_crr = #{prjctEsntlCrr}, prjct_strt_date = #{prjctStrtDate}, prjct_end_date = #{prjctEndDate}, prjct_prd = #{prjctPrd}, prjct_lctn = #{prjctLctn} WHERE prjct_sq = #{prjctSq}
mapper.select:
WITH EssentialSkills AS (
SELECT TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(prjct_esntl_skl, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1)) AS skill_name FROM P5_TBL_PROJECT JOIN ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 ) numbers ON CHAR_LENGTH(prjct_esntl_skl) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(prjct_esntl_skl, ',', '')) >= numbers.n - 1 WHERE prjct_sq = #{prjctSq} ), MatchedSkills AS (
SELECT skl.skl_code_sq FROM EssentialSkills es JOIN P2_TBL_SKILL_CODE_S skl ON TRIM(es.skill_name) = TRIM(skl.skl_sc_name) ), MatchedMembers AS (
SELECT r.rsm_sq FROM P2_TBL_SKILL_CODE_RESUME_R r JOIN MatchedSkills ms ON r.skl_code_sq = ms.skl_code_sq GROUP BY r.rsm_sq HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.skl_code_sq) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EssentialSkills) -- 필수 스킬을 모두 보유한 사람만 )
SELECT DISTINCT m.mbr_eml_adrs FROM P3_TBL_MEMBER_M m JOIN MatchedMembers mm ON m.mbr_sq = mm.rsm_sq WHERE m.mbr_eml_rcv_yn = 'Y';
